prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1257; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with damage concentrated on the rear bumper cover, the left quarter panel, and the adjacent taillight assembly, which lines up well with the low-speed rear-corner contact described at the scene. The proposed repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing and blending the quarter panel, and replacing the rear reinforcement bar. Labor hours requested fit the extent of the work shown in the photos, and the parts list and charges on the invoice are consistent without any duplicated line items. Nothing in the file suggests prior damage to this area, so the repairs are estimated as a single, collision-related scope.
